title: The no-vendor mode: devbin from Homebrew runs a project that carries no vendored copy of devbin
objective: devbin, installed from Homebrew and on PATH, runs a project from its working directory: the project's config.yaml, cmd/ and help/, with the install's own lib. hv schedules this package, and it does not start before hv's word.
body:
## Not before hv's word

hv schedules this package (vc decision 64 and todo 213). It waited for devbin to be public, which it is.

## What it changes

Today a project carries its own runtime: bin/devbin and bin/.devbin/lib, vendored. bin/devbin finds PROJECT_ROOT, DEVBIN_DIR and DEVBIN_LIB from its own place. An install tree, such as Homebrew's keg, refuses every verb but the few it answers for itself, eg install, shell-init and use, with "this is a devbin INSTALL, not a project". The mode changes devbin's rule that a project carries its own runtime. Under the seam (ST0001's design), `bin/devbin` and everything under `bin/.devbin/lib/` are devbin's and are vendored into the project, and `config.yaml`, `cmd/` and `help/` are the project's. In the mode, devbin's half stays in the install.

## Where it came from

Another estate's session, which vendors devbin in many repositories, asked for it on 2026-10-16, and devbin-vc put it to hv. hv ruled on 2026-10-25 that it waits for devbin to be public.

## Open

Its design and its shape (devbin-ic's word) are set when hv schedules it, and its size, L, is a first estimate until then.
